text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard wo... Huh? 
That's...!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, you plan on following me all the 
way around the outer perimeter?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! As your rival, there's no way I 
could overlook your hard work!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Me, fighting tooth and nail so as not to 
lose to you...! Ah, what a truly moving 
scenario!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I don't know anything about that...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahahaha!! What a splendid start! 
Allow me to overtake you in magnificent 
style!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fugughhh! Wh-What was that?! Just what 
kind of rival is sheee?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha, gotcha, totally understood☆ It's 
that whole "unbreakable bond" thing, isn't 
it~

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty. Guess I'll just keep an eye on 
those two and lap the perimeter without 
getting too close...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Stealth is the absolute 
fundamental when admiring your fave!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yours truly, Digi-tan, puts ninjas to 
shame when it comes to sneaking around so 
as not to bother her faves!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm off for another run! 
*patter-patter-patter*!

A short while later, Agnes Digital 
returned in a state of absolute 
euphoria...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hnghhh...! I-It's true that running any 
more than this is overdoing it, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's running the perimeter, it's 
not training, it's a hobby— or rather, 
yeah! It's not exercise, it's stan 
activity!

Agnes Digital continued to make excuses, 
but I sent her home without pushing her.
